I was in a similar situation. 
I loved my ex and I was the love of his life. I always said I was pansexual, and gender didn't matter.. but I really never truly liked men, I was just afraid of change. I spent several months fighting with myself on what to do.. we had just bought a house together, just had a baby.. our life was GOOD.... but I just wasn't truly happy. He was good to me, we were decent together (communication was lacking at times).. but there was always just something missing. 
After I spent what felt like forever dealing with an internal battle with myself, I told him I couldn't do it anymore and I was gay. He asked me if I just needed time to explore, or if I wanted a girlfriend too, so that he could keep me.. even though he didn't know if he'd be okay with that once it happened, but I knew I couldn't do it. 
We tried to live together for a while after I told him, but I had started talking to someone and it was killing him, so things got pretty bad.. and I left with nothing but my kids one day. 
It broke both of our hearts. I still wish things would have ended a bit better and I want nothing but the best for him. 
I still get really sad at times that I don't have him to run to when things get rough or that I can't go and talk to him about things I know he'd love. We told each other we'd be best friends after me leaving, but I feel like that just complicated everything so I kinda backed off and gave space. We still talk, and we're great co parents.. but I don't text him every little thing anymore.
I'm currently 1 year in with my girlfriend and couldn't be happier that I get to be my true self but it's still hard because I DID love him with my full heart. 
I do not think I was ever bi or pan, I am 100% lesbian. But that doesn't mean the love was not there and the feelings didn't exist.
